This also cleans up ec3po printouts and prints ptys by name. CHROMIUM: config: turn on CONFIG_I2C_CHARDEV for Qualcomm This was left off, but it's on everywhere else and Chrome OS expects it in general. NOTE: some boards have this as "=m" and others "=y". In general "=m" is preferred unless there's some urgent need for it to be "=y", like if we need to do an I2C-based firmware device at bootup. See CL:422907 and CL:366000 as examples. This is the equivalent of: echo 'CONFIG_I2C_CHARDEV=m' >> \ chromeos/config/arm64/chromiumos-qualcomm.flavour.config ./chromeos/scripts/kernelconfig olddefconfig ...atop an already normalized config. BUG=chromium:795946 TEST=Boot and "modprobe i2c-dev"; can use "i2cdetect" Change-Id: I07911683f2ae7b0b17457fed53ee0451c98aa7e2 Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/969594 Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>
